articles.title: Middle-East: Iran proposes Hormuz plan, Donald Trump reportedly refuses
articles.description: The United States had yet to publicly respond on Saturday after Iran offered a plan to reopen the strategic Strait of Hormuz, though reports indicated that President Donald Trump had rejected the proposal. The waterway key to the world's oil supply is central to the conflict between the US and Iran, which is at a stalemate after nearly seven months, though new mediation efforts took place this week.

related.title: Trump reportedly rejects Iran’s seven-day plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz
related.description: US President Donald Trump has reportedly rejected an Iranian plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday. Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi presented the proposal to Trump’s envoy Steve Witkoff a day earlier on the sidelines of a UN gathering in New York. The plan stipulated that the important waterway would reopen seven days after an agreement was reached.
related.normalizedTitle: trump reportedly rejects iran s seven day plan to reopen strait of hormuz

articles.title: CNN removed from Trump press pool despite judge order to reinstate White House access
articles.description: US news outlet CNN has been removed from a press pool that is accompanying President Donald Trump on a trip to Tennessee on Saturday. Last week, the Trump administration barred CNN, along with MS NOW and Politico, from accessing the White House. A judge then ordered their access temporarily restored, saying the move was likely unconstitutional.

articles.title: Bangkok declares flood disaster after massive 48-hour downpour
articles.description: Thailand’s capital Bangkok declared a flood disaster on Saturday after more than 300 millimetres of rain in less than 48 hours, leaving canals overflowing and streets submerged. “It’s like at my waist level now,” a local said. The governor has urged people not to panic, saying the situation is stabilising.

articles.title: Ligue 1 : condamné pour violences conjugales, Abdelatif Kherradji est autorisé à reprendre l’arbitrage
articles.description: Le Conseil de discipline de la FFF a classé sans suite le dossier de l’arbitre de Ligue 1, condamné en août à six mois de prison avec sursis. Il pourra donc reprendre l’arbitrage, sous réserve de son appel pénal.

articles.title: France: Pope says 'authentic secularity' does not exclude religion
articles.description: Pope Leo XIV said on a visit to France on Friday that "authentic secularity" should not exclude religion, in a country where law has for more than a century separated church and state. "An authentic secularity, then, consists not in excluding religion from the public sphere or from education, but in striving to ensure that the state and religious institutions maintain dialogue and join forces in the service of the common good," he said.

articles.title: "C'est vraiment difficile pour les gens" : un mois après les crues dévastatrices, le Népal peine à se reconstruire

Il y a un mois jour pour jour, le nord du Népal connaissait l'une des pires catastrophes naturelles de son histoire récente. Une crue dévastatrice dont le pays peine encore à se relever.

articles.title: «Renouveau du catholicisme», critique de l’IA et de l’aide à mourir… Ce que la presse internationale a retenu des premiers pas de Léon XIV à Paris

articles.title: Live: Pope urges newly baptised young people to persevere in their faith in secular France
articles.description: Pope Leo XIV on Saturday met with young French Catholic converts, encouraging them to persevere in their faith “even amid the thorns” of a secular world. Meanwhile, an estimated 600,000 people gathered at Place de la Concorde in central Paris, where the pontiff will celebrate Mass this afternoon. Follow our liveblog for all the latest on the pope's four-day visit to France.

articles.title: En Allemagne, la pénurie de chauffeurs-routiers fait craindre des répercussions sur toute la chaîne d'approvisionnement en Europe
articles.description: Avec des conditions de travail difficiles, un prix à la pompe en hausse et des départs à la retraite non remplacés, ce sont jusqu'à 120 000 chauffeurs-routiers qui manquent sur les routes allemandes. Une pénurie qui peut impacter la chaîne d'approvisionnement européenne.

articles.title: Privés d’un outil destiné à récupérer des preuves numériques cruciales pour leurs enquêtes, des magistrats français interpellent le gouvernement

articles.title: Après cinq siècles de mauvais traitements, un chef-d’œuvre de Dürer fait l’objet d’une restauration d’envergure à Prague

articles.title: «Catastrophe inimaginable» : le corps d’une touriste retrouvé après l'effondrement meurtrier d'un immeuble à Athènes
